detail.finding: Gushakisha kopi y'umukino yashyizwe muri mudasobwa…
detail.notInstalled: Nta kopi yashyizwemo yabonetse, kandi nta kibazo: decoy ntiyirirwa iyikenera.
detail.noteDone: Ushobora kuyihagarika ubu, umukoro ugomba kuba wamaze kubarwa.
detail.noteRunning: Porogaramu ikorera inyuma. Ushobora kugabanya idirishya rikajya mu gashushanyo k'akabati.
detail.noExe.title: Discord ntarabona exe y'uyu mukino
detail.noExe.text: Ntiyashobora kumenyekana binyuze muri porogaramu. Kanda “Vugurura ububikoshingiro” nyuma: igihe Discord izongeramo exe, umukino uzashoboka gukoreshwa.
running.title: Ibikora
running.empty.title: Nta kintu kiri gukora
running.empty.text: Fungura umukino mu isomero hanyuma ukande “Tangiza decoy”.
settings.title: Igenamiterere
settings.language.desc: Ururimi rw'ibanze. Indimi nshya zongerwamo nk'amadosiye mu bubiko bwa locales.
settings.defaultTime.desc: Iminota yo kugumana inzira (process). Ibisanzwe ni 16, si 15: ubutumwa bwa Discord busaba iminota 15 yo gukina, ariko Discord ikenera kugera ku munota umwe kugira ngo ibone umukino mushya, bityo 15 nyirizina ntiyaba ihagije.
settings.smartTimer.desc: Ibarira-gihe ritangira igihe Discord yamaze kubona decoy, aho kuba igihe uyitangirije. Kugira ngo ibimenye, porogaramu isoma gusa imirongo yerekeye umukino urimo gukina muri log ya Discord yo kuri mudasobwa; nta kintu kibikwa cyangwa cyoherezwa ahandi.
settings.autoUpdate.desc: Kugenzura GitHub mu ntangiriro no muri buri masaha 6 hanyuma ugakuramo verisiyo nshya mu mfuruka. Gushyiramo bihora bitegereza kwemeza kwawe, kandi dosiye zigenzurwa n'umukono wazo wa gisivile (digital signature).
detail.waitingNote: Discord ikenera kugera ku munota umwe kugira ngo ibone umukino. Ibarira-gihe ritangira igihe ibonye decoy.
detail.assumed: Discord ntiyabyemeje, igihe kirimo kubarwa uko byagenda kose.
settings.autoStop.desc: Decoy yizimya ubwayo igihe cyagenwe kigeze.
settings.tray: Gushyira mu bubiko bw'akabati mugihe ifunzwe
settings.tray.desc: Decoy zikomeza gukora mu gihe porogaramu iri mu gashushanyo k'akabati.
settings.source.desc: Urutonde rusange rwa Discord · imikino {n} · ivuguruwe {date}
settings.showNoExe.desc: Imikino aho Discord itaramenya porogaramu ikoreshwa (ntishobora gutangizwa).
settings.dataDir.portable: Uburyo bwo gutwara: byose bibikwa iruhande rwa decoy.exe.
settings.legal: Decoy ntikoresha ikimenyetso cyawe cya Discord (token) kandi ntiyakira imikoro mu izina ryawe. Kwigana porogaramu y'umukino bishobora kunyuranya n'amategeko ya Discord, bikoreshe ku ngaruka zawe bwite.
toast.launched: “{name}” itangijwe mu gihe cy'imin {n}. Discord igomba kuyibona mu masegonda nka 15.
toast.timeUp: Igihe cyageze, umukoro wagombye kuba wabazwe
lab.title: Laboratwari
lab.subtitle: Ahadusanzwe hihishe: hatangiza decoy nyinshi icyarimwe.
lab.count.desc: Imikino itoranywa ku buryo bw'impanuka, iyisanzwe ikora irasimbukwa. Buri mukino umara imin {n} (byagenwe mu Igenamiterere).
lab.warn: Buri decoy ni inzira itandukanye ifite idirishya. Nyinshi icyarimwe zishobora gufata mudasobwa yawe: buri nzira n'idirishya bikoresha ububiko (memory), kandi nyuma y'amadirishya ibihumbi runaka Windows ishobora guhagarika kurema andi mashya. Nufunga Decoy, decoy zose zirahagarara.
lab.risk.mid: Uhereye kuri decoy zigera kuri 250, Discord ubwayo ishobora gutangira kugenda buhoro: ikurikirana buri mukino urimo gukora kandi ikabimenyesha seriveri zayo.
lab.risk.high: Akaga: igihe decoy 5.000 zatangirizwaga rimwe, Discord yarengeje 10 GB ya RAM kandi igakora crash buri masegonda 30 kugeza amakuru yayo yo mu mashini asubiwemo bushya. Decoy ihagarika byose niba ububiko bwa Discord bwiyongereye cyane, ariko nta cyemezo.
lab.discordRam: Kuri ubu Discord irimo gukoresha {gb} GB ya RAM.
lab.unlock.desc: Hejuru y'uyu mupaka Discord yarananiwe mu bikorwa. Yifungure gusa niba usobanukiwe n'ingaruka.
guard.tripped: Decoy zose zahagaritswe kugira ngo hashingwe Discord: irimo gukoresha {gb} GB ya RAM (yiyongereyeho {grew} GB). Niba itinda, yongere uyitangize.
lab.next: Imikino ikurikirana mu buryo bw'inyuguti. Icyiciro gikurikira gitangirana na “{name}”.
lab.limit: Windows yahagaritse gutangiza inzira nshya nyuma ya {n}: iyo ni imbibi za sisitemu.
notify.title: Igihe cyageze
